name: TBX Term Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds local v2 term record import, exact language selection, glossary reports and batch import.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Settings now end with a More from NoteMods group, where you can turn this tab off or open it again.
tip: Language labels are compared as written, so en, en-US and en-GB are separate choices. Pick the exact two labels for your columns.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. TBX Term Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to bring your term bases into Obsidian.
